title: Bath time, cat style: your cat scoops from a bucket and somehow stays dry
summary: Turn one photo of your cat into a short bathroom clip where it scoops from a bucket like it's having a wash, stays bone dry, then walks off.
why: A trend template page lists a TikTok posted November 7, 2026 of a grey cat dipping a scoop into a pink bucket in a tiled bathroom, staying dry, then walking off toward a bedroom. The page says it had 1.4 million views and 41,000 likes on November 14.
steps: Pick a clear photo of your cat sitting up, face to the camera, in good light.
Paste the main prompt into an image-to-video tool. Ask for about 12 seconds, vertical, with the camera held still at cat height.
Add a caption that tells the joke, like "Bath done. Didn't get wet once."
Add a calm, cheerful sound that's free to use in your app, and label the post as made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the dry bucket bath
prompts.text: Animate the cat in this photo. Vertical video, about 12 seconds, low camera at cat height, held still. The cat sits upright on a white tiled bathroom floor next to a pink plastic bucket with a white scoop in it. With one front paw it dips the scoop into the bucket, lifts it, and tips it over its head like someone taking a bucket bath, but not a single drop lands on it. Its fur stays fluffy and dry. It does this twice, looking calm and pleased with itself. Then it turns to the camera with a slow blink, puts the scoop down and walks out of the bathroom toward a cosy bedroom. Keep the cat's face, fur colour and markings the same as the photo. Soft warm bathroom light. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: spa day with a towel
prompts.text: Animate the cat in this photo. Vertical video, about 12 seconds, camera held still. The cat sits on a bath mat beside a small wooden bucket, with a rolled white towel and a candle on the tub edge. It dips a little scoop, pretends to pour it over its back, and stays perfectly dry. Then it drapes the small towel over its head like after a spa visit and strolls away. Keep the cat looking exactly like the photo. Calm, warm light. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: small business
prompts.text: Animate this photo of our shop pet [upload]. Vertical video, about 12 seconds, low camera held still. The pet sits by a bucket and scoop in a clean, bright washroom at our [type of business, for example: grooming salon / spa / soap shop]. It scoops and pours like it's having a wash and stays completely dry, then looks at the camera, pleased. A small sign on the wall reads "[your real offer, for example: Book a bath for your pet]". Keep the pet true to the photo. Friendly, funny mood. No logos or brand names.

tips: Say "stays completely dry" clearly in the prompt. The joke is that the cat does the whole routine and never gets wet.
Keep the camera low and still, like a phone propped on the bathroom floor.
This is a pretend clip. Never try to bathe a real cat this way for a video.
Only use photos of your own pet, or a friend's pet with their OK.
